```figdown
# FigDown — figures as text. Spec: https://github.com/FigDown/figdown
figdown 0.1 block
title "Certificate renewal automation"

block scheduler "Scheduler"
block renewaljob "Renewal Job"
block caclient "CA Client"
block ca "Certificate Authority"
block deployagent "Deploy Agent"
block service "Service"

edge scheduler renewaljob
edge renewaljob caclient
edge caclient ca
edge renewaljob deployagent
edge deployagent service
```

This document declares a block (architecture/dataflow) diagram with six components and five directed connections, following the structure described:

1. **Scheduler** triggers the **Renewal Job** on a timer
2. **Renewal Job** requests a certificate from the **CA Client**
3. **CA Client** communicates with the **Certificate Authority** to obtain the new certificate
4. **Renewal Job** hands off to the **Deploy Agent** once the certificate is obtained
5. **Deploy Agent** restarts the **Service** to pick up the new certificate

The five edges correspond precisely to the five connections described in the figure specification. The layout engine will position these components to minimize crossing and produce a readable diagram.
